results.flow_input_to_sink: Caller-supplied `quoteToken_` (`address`), `vrfWrapper_` (`address`), and deployment caller `msg.sender` flow into `VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase` external staticcall `IVRFV2PlusWrapper(vrfWrapper_).link()`, immutable assignments (`i_linkToken`, `i_vrfV2PlusWrapper`, `factory`, `quoteToken`), and implementation lock storage writes (`initialized = true`, `status = Status.Refunding`).
results.flow_security_relevance: Establishes the immutable trust roots (`factory`, `quoteToken`, `i_vrfV2PlusWrapper`, `i_linkToken`) shared in bytecode across all ERC-1167 minimal-proxy clones of `Raffle`, performs an external `STATICCALL` to `vrfWrapper_.link()` during construction, and locks the implementation contract storage (`initialized = true`, `status = Status.Refunding`) while leaving clone storage slots (including ERC-7201 `ReentrancyGuard` storage and `prizeToken`) uninitialized until `initialize()` runs on each clone.
results.flow_summary: Successful deployment of the `Raffle` implementation contract (either by `RaffleFactory.constructor` via `new Raffle(quoteToken_, vrfWrapper_)` or by a direct deployer) validates `vrfWrapper_` and `quoteToken_`, queries `vrfWrapper_.link()` via external staticcall in `VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase`, binds immutable `factory`, `quoteToken`, `i_vrfV2PlusWrapper`, and `i_linkToken` references into runtime bytecode, and permanently locks the implementation contract's own storage with `initialized = true` and `status = Status.Refunding`.
results.flow_terminal_action: Writes `initialized = true` and `status = Status.Refunding` to implementation storage and returns deployed `Raffle` runtime bytecode with embedded immutables (`factory`, `quoteToken`, `i_vrfV2PlusWrapper`, `i_linkToken`).
